sentences.text: The Independent Commission Against Corruption surveyed 502 NSW residents in May and June 2006 to inform and monitor its prevention and education work.
sentences.support:
the seventh community attitude survey 
which was administered to 502 NSW residents during May and June 2006.

sentences.text: The survey examined perceptions of corruption, attitudes to reporting it and knowledge of ICAC.
sentences.support:
perceptions of corruption, 
attitudes towards reporting corruption and awareness and perceptions of the ICAC.

sentences.text: ICAC reported that 92% supported reporting corruption, but 68% expected people who reported it to suffer and only about a third knew where to report.
sentences.support:
Only one-third of the sample believed they 
knew where to report corruption.

sentences.text: ICAC concluded that attitudes had largely remained stable since 2003 and cautioned that the survey could not establish actual corruption levels or how people would act.
sentences.support:
the survey reported the views and opinions 
of individuals within the NSW community

findings.quote:
In conclusion, the present survey indicated that community attitudes towards 
corruption and the ICAC have remained relatively stable in most respects since 
2003.

Only one-third of the sample believed they 
knew where to report corruption.

notes: Survey perceptions do not establish actual levels of corruption. No numbered recommendations list.
